verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's personalization docs describe personal instructions that persist: in Codex they are stored in a global AGENTS.md file, which Codex reads before doing any work. Memories also carry context from earlier chats into future work, and projects supply standing context. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party description of the ChatGPT chat-side custom-instructions setting and how it applies to every response, plus independent hands-on corroboration that instructions persist reliably.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can set persistent custom instructions and preferences that shape every response

citations.quote: In Codex, these personal instructions are stored in your global `AGENTS.md` file.
Codex reads AGENTS.md files before doing any work.
Memories let ChatGPT carry useful context from earlier chats into future work.
Use a project to organize related chats and give ChatGPT the context it needs.
